inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Headlights cut the fog, city lights behind
Leaving all the ghosts and heavy minds
The radio is humming a familiar song
We don't know where we're going but we've been here long
Neon bleeds on the wet asphalt floor
I'm not looking back at what I can't ignore

[Chorus]
Drive into the dark, let the engine roar
Take me to the edge of the horizon's shore
It's bittersweet air in my lungs tonight
But the morning light is gonna feel alright
Fade out, fade out, into the blue
I am finally free, I am breaking through

[inst]

[Verse]
Rearview mirror empty, no more rain
Washing off the dust of yesterday's pain
The highway stretches out like an open hand
I understand now that I cannot stand
Still in the shadows where the secrets keep
Now I have nothing left for them to reap

[Chorus]
Drive into the dark, let the engine roar
Take me to the edge of the horizon's shore
It's bittersweet air in my lungs tonight
But the morning light is gonna feel alright
Fade out, fade out, into the blue
I am finally free, I am breaking through

[Bridge]
One last blink of the streetlight sign
A goodbye whispered, one last time
The city sleeps, it doesn't know
That I am letting go, letting go

[Chorus]
Drive into the dark, let the engine roar
Take me to the edge of the horizon's shore
It's bittersweet air in my lungs tonight
But the morning light is gonna feel alright
Fade out, fade out, into the blue
I am finally free, I am breaking through
